about_the_game:
WELCOME TO VERTEX
Vertex is a third and first person multiplayer fighting game set in a grim world.

INSPIRED EVOLUTION
Heavily inspired by classic space wizard series of games, it offers a deep and responsive combat system.

FREE MOVEMENT
Vertex allows players to engage in a variety of stances and moves while having the freedom to perform acrobatics and special powers against other players.

RANGED & MELEE
Featuring ranged and melee combat, it delivers a fresh, unique style of game play.

RICH LORE
Set in a sci-fi world, players will be able to choose and customize their character in the game, fighting for one of two factions as well as unlock story fragments.

MODDING SUPPORT
Vertex will feature extensive modding support, enabling players to create their own content for the game using Unreal Engine 5.

short_description: Experience Freeform Melee Combat in this action-packed multiplayer freestyle sword and gunplay online game. Set in a dystopian world where traumatic events of the past are threatening their future, chose between bio-enhanced sword-wielding acrobats or highly trained elite military soldiers.
